description: Isolated CHS candidate for a between-child At Home versus At School manipulation. Each child receives one stable context, one event, and one six-story role set. Pair ratings remain interleaved one after each story and retain that child's assigned Home or School room.
questionAudioTiming: original NaturalReaders recordings with natural comma timing
locationCaptionTreatment: The Home or School sentence appears once in the palette-colored top caption; the former blue-and-white lower card is inactive.
narratorMouthTiming: The yellow narrator mouth starts on actual media playback and stops on buffering, pause, abort, emptied media, end, error, or researcher navigation.
contextIntroduction: After the kid and both candidate characters are introduced, the story says, 'They are all at the kid's home' or 'They are all at the kid's school.'
visualTreatment: Furnished Home and School rooms with subtle palette-matched walls. In the Home room, only the empty artwork field and four original wooden frame bars receive a faint same-hue palette tint inside fixed hard masks; the picture mat and shadow, surrounding wall, lamp, natural wooden floor, neutral couch and cast shadow remain untouched. The abstract picture people are removed, pillows and selected furniture details remain shared gray, and the original character RGB and geometry remain unchanged.
visualIntegrity: Edge-connected and very large pure-white background components are transparent in both story and follow-up layers. The fixed enclosed white strip between the middle adult's legs and the box is also removed from the 24 directional Help foregrounds. Eye whites, white label text, characters, boxes, and colored captions remain opaque; retained opaque RGB pixels are unchanged.
participantSafety: The runtime performs an audio preflight before the study. All 18 assignment cells now have complete prerecorded Evelyn coverage; it does not substitute browser speech.
